1.web: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
1.asv: A soft answer turneth away wrath; But a grievous word stirreth up anger.

2.web: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of fools gush out folly.
2.asv: The tongue of the wise uttereth knowledge aright; But the mouth of fools poureth out folly.

3.web: Yahweh’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
3.asv: The eyes of Jehovah are in every place, Keeping watch upon the evil and the good.

4.web: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.
4.asv: A gentle tongue is a tree of life; But perverseness therein is a breaking of the spirit.

5.web: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.
5.asv: A fool despiseth his father’s correction; But he that regardeth reproof getteth prudence.

6.web: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.
6.asv: In the house of the righteous is much treasure; But in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.

7.web: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
7.asv: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge; But the heart of the foolishdoethnot so.

8.web: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
8.asv: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to Jehovah; But the prayer of the upright is his delight.

9.web: The way of the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.
9.asv: The way of the wicked is an abomination to Jehovah; But he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.

10.web: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way: whoever hates reproof shall die.
10.asv: There is grievous correction for him that forsaketh the way; And he that hateth reproof shall die.

11.web: Sheol and Abaddon are before Yahweh— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!
11.asv: Sheol and Abaddon are before Jehovah; How much more then the hearts of the children of men!

12.web: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.
12.asv: A scoffer loveth not to be reproved; He will not go unto the wise.

13.web: A glad heart makes a cheerful face; but an aching heart breaks the spirit.
13.asv: A glad heart maketh a cheerful countenance; But by sorrow of heart the spirit is broken.

14.web: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.
14.asv: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge; But the mouth of fools feedeth on folly.

15.web: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.
15.asv: All the days of the afflicted are evil; But he that is of a cheerful heart hath a continual feast.

16.web: Better is little, with the fear of Yahweh, than great treasure with trouble.
16.asv: Better is little, with the fear of Jehovah, Than great treasure and trouble therewith.

17.web: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.
17.asv: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, Than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.

18.web: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.
18.asv: A wrathful man stirreth up contention; But he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.

19.web: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.
19.asv: The way of the sluggard is as a hedge of thorns; But the path of the upright is made a highway.

20.web: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.
20.asv: A wise son maketh a glad father; But a foolish man despiseth his mother.

21.web: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.
21.asv: Folly is joy to him that is void of wisdom; But a man of understanding maketh straight his going.

22.web: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.
22.asv: Where there is no counsel, purposes are disappointed; But in the multitude of counsellors they are established.

23.web: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!
23.asv: A man hath joy in the answer of his mouth; And a word in due season, how good is it!

24.web: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.
24.asv: To the wise the way of lifegoethupward, That he may depart from Sheol beneath.

25.web: Yahweh will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.
25.asv: Jehovah will root up the house of the proud; But he will establish the border of the widow.

26.web: Yahweh detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.
26.asv: Evil devices are an abomination to Jehovah; But pleasant wordsarepure.

27.web: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.
27.asv: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; But he that hateth bribes shall live.

28.web: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.
28.asv: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer; But the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.

29.web: Yahweh is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
29.asv: Jehovah is far from the wicked; But he heareth the prayer of the righteous.

30.web: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.
30.asv: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart; Andgood tidings make the bones fat.

31.web: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.
31.asv: The ear that hearkeneth to the reproof of life Shall abide among the wise.

32.web: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.
32.asv: He that refuseth correction despiseth his own soul; But he that hearkeneth to reproof getteth understanding.

33.web: The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.
33.asv: The fear of Jehovah is the instruction of wisdom; And before honorgoethhumility.
